text:
anya: LucidCore asked for a short reproducible perf/W test on their 'LC-Alpha' board for our 13B model. scope: steady-state perf/W, tokens/sec, and kernel stability.
caleb: good. propose 1h runs, 15m warmup, measure last 45m; power sample 1s; thermals 5s. two configs: redwood-default and lucid-alpha-tune.
lucid-eng: we'll provide external powermeter CSV and IPMI. firmware: lc-alpha-v1.0. kernel tune script: toggle_lc_alpha.sh.
anya: infra: 3 identical perf nodes in perf-pool, isolated VLAN, local collector. reproducible bundle required (docker tag + run.sh).
ops-bot: lab slot suggested: 2026-11-08 20:00 PT. booking pending confirmation.
caleb: collector schema (strings): run_id, partner, model, kernel_label, firmware_id, batch_size, seq_len, tokens_per_sec, power_mean_w, power_p95_w, thermal_max_c, latency_p95_ms, raw_power_series_url, artifact_url.
lucid-eng: we'll also provide a quick logits-compare script to confirm tune doesn't change outputs beyond epsilon.
anya: risks: thermal plateau, sensor drift, IPMI timeouts. mitigations: calibration step, redundant meter, preflight stress.
caleb: action items: caleb -> perf script + baseline runs; lucid-eng -> powermeter + toggle script; anya -> reproducibility bundle + collector mapping. dry-run: 2026-11-06 09:00 PT; official: 2026-11-08 20:00 PT. ping here when runbook uploaded. :rocket:
